key_claims.claim: Low-intensity pulsed ultrasound applied postpartum accelerates uterine involution and reduces postpartum complications compared to sham treatment
An evidence-based preterm birth risk threshold can rationalize which patients should receive antenatal corticosteroids
Prenatal ADHD stimulant or atomoxetine exposure is associated with increased preterm birth, low birthweight, and possible congenital anomaly risk; neurodevelopmental signals are modest
Transabdominal cerclage is supported by RCT-level evidence specifically for recurrent spontaneous preterm birth before 28 weeks after failed transvaginal cerclage
Maternal cardiovascular phenotyping in preeclampsia can guide individualized antihypertensive therapy selection
